export_evidence: No export record seen. The only shipment data retrieved is India IMPORT customs data, not exports. Exact line from ImportKey (https://importkey.com/countries/india/eskay-iodine-private-limited): "2026-02-28 ESKAY IODINE PRIVATE LIMITED TO THE ORDER RAW MATERIAL USED IN THE FEED TO OVERCOME THE IODINE DEFICIT IN ANIMAL POTASSIUMIODIDE STABILIZED- NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India Durban, S AFRICA 28276010 1112067" — origin Durban/Santos/Sydney, destination India, i.e. inbound cargo. Page counter: "Total Shipments 903 Records detected", "Trading Partners 10", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 (dates 2026-02-24 to 2026-02-28). No outbound B/L, no foreign buyer, no export destination was visible in any row.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. Attempts: thecompanycheck.com, tofler.in, zaubacorp.com all returned HTTP 403/404; eximpedia.app and volza.com returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable (connection refused) for the whole session. No domestic supply record was seen, and equally no negative finding can be asserted.
note: Direction of trade is the key finding: the 903 customs records on ImportKey are INDIA IMPORT records — Eskay Iodine is the Indian consignee receiving iodine/iodide raw materials (HS 28276010 potassium iodide, 28299030 calcium iodate/sodium metaperiodate, 29420090 L-selenomethionine, 39059990 povidone iodine) from Durban, Santos, Sydney, Taipei and the UK. That confirms the company is an active iodine/iodide processor and buyer, but it is NOT evidence of export shipments. Declared HS codes 282760 and 282990 match the actual inbound product codes seen (28276010, 28299030), so no HS correction is needed on the import side. Export status therefore remains unknown, not confirmed — no outbound bill of lading with a foreign buyer was observed. Domestic supply status also unknown: no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record was retrievable because every registry and aggregator I tried blocked the request (403) or the search backend was down. Per Rule 5, I am not upgrading 'website/catalogue presence' to fact, and I am not writing 'no supply traces found' either, because the failure was access-related, not an absence of records. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source I could open. Recommended next step: paid Volza/Eximpedia export-side view or the company's MCA filings (AOC-4) for the domestic/export revenue split.
